children: Aditxt said the parties to the Business Combination Agreement for its subsidiary Ignite Proteomics and Copley Acquisition mutually terminated the deal effective Oct. 9, 2026. The termination, executed under Section 8.1(a), carries no termination fees; each party will bear its own expenses and provided mutual releases. All related ancillary agreements, including support, insider letter amendment and lock-ups, were terminated automatically. Aditxt indicated it will evaluate alternative strategic options following the end of the SPAC transaction.
